23:1.text: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:

23:2.text: They who are during their prayer humbly intent

23:3.text: And they who turn away from ill speech

23:4.text: And they who are observant of zakāh

23:5.text: And they who guard their private parts

23:6.text: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,
for indeed, they will not be blamed -

23:7.text: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -

23:8.text: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

23:9.text: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -

23:12.text: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

23:13.text: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop

23:14.text: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump
the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.

23:15.text: Then indeed, after that you are to die.

23:16.text: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
